method: QUOTED UNDER A 200-WORD BUDGET (196 words used), from Cancer Council Australia 'Clinical practice guidelines for the prevention, early detection, and management of colorectal cancer: Risk and screening based on family history' v1.2 (published 2026-05-25), retrieved 2026-09-23 as MAGICapp JSON. Every pass claim is machine re-checkable. LICENCE: Free to read, NOT openly licensed. Cancer Council Australia's guideline FAQ: fair dealing needs only correct citation; reproducing 'more than 200 words or figures/tables' needs permission from guidelines@cancer.org.au. So quotes here are capped at 200 words per source guideline (enforced by the generator) and tables were stripped from the retrieved text before quoting, so none can be quoted.
